name: default-label-used-when-label-omitted
note: the rule omits the label, so the classifier's default_label 'code' is read (0.9); this is specifically the default_label's score, not the max over labels (math is lower)

name: primary-reads-lone-score
note: a label-less classifier whose model returns a single score is read via primary(); here the lone score 0.8 matches

name: primary-multi-entry-scores-zero
note: primary() only reads a lone score; when the label-less classifier's model returns more than one score it returns 0 rather than guess a label, so the rule misses even though one entry is 0.9, and routing falls back to default_model
